the development of a microgripper integrated with force sensor, interface circuitry, and control technique for the successful operation of the microgripper.

the design and fabrication of an electrostatically operated microgripper integrated with force sensor, interface electronics and control.

the proposed system is capable of operating the MEMS based micro-gripper and force sensor successfully.

the proposed system is capable of operating the microgripper with the force sensor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we successfully developed the interface circuitry and the control technique of a MEMS based micro gripper.
we have developed a microgripper which is capable of grabbing, holding and transporting micron sized objects and also capable of measuring the size of a micro object.
the designed interface circuit and controller is a step forward towards the development of microgripper based micro-robotic systems for handling micro-objects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed system can control the microgripper in a closed loop fashion and can measure the size of the rigid micro-object in the range of 1 to 10 microns.
the interface circuitry is able to control the microgripper in real time with the help of computer GUI.
a complete system is developed to operate the microgripper with the help of interface electronics and controller.
